mapper.sql: o.id AS id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, o.enterprise_id AS enterpriseId, e.ent_name AS enterpriseName, o.insurance_type_id AS insuranceTypeId, it.type_name AS insuranceTypeName, it.category AS insuranceTypeCategory, o.org_id AS orgId, so.org_name AS orgName, o.region_code AS regionCode, o.region_name AS regionName, o.guarantee_amount AS guaranteeAmount, o.premium_amount AS premiumAmount, o.premium_rate AS premiumRate, o.status AS status, o.apply_date AS applyDate, o.effective_date AS effectiveDate, o.expire_date AS expireDate

FROM tender_order o LEFT JOIN project p ON p.id = o.project_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = o.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN insurance_type it ON it.id = o.insurance_type_id LEFT JOIN sys_org so ON so.id = o.org_id
